leads.claim: Unidentified metal fragments found near Koro, Mali, were identified as debris from a U.S. rocket launch.
leads.why: The document explicitly identifies the material as conventional debris from a known U.S. rocket launch.
leads.quote: UNIDENTIFIED METAL FRAGMENTS FOUND NEAR KORO IN SOUTH-CENTRAL MALI MAY BE THE REMAINS OF A U.S. ROCKET

doc_verdict: This document contains no evidence of UAP-related material, as the only mentioned fragments are explicitly identified as conventional rocket debris.
